title: Fog
description: A cold window pane over a landscape at dusk. Hold to breathe a warm bloom of condensation onto the glass, write in it with your finger, and watch the strokes bead, drip and evaporate; breathe again and the old writing comes back as a ghost.
intent: One quiet physical ritual finished to the edge: breath condensing on cold glass, a finger writing through it, water gathering and running, and the whole thing evaporating from the edges inward.
